blocks.text: Maadde ke saath tawanai bhi tabeei mahol aur jandaron ke darmiyan bahti hai. Maadde ke bar-aks, jo chakkar lagata hai, tawanai sirf aik simt mein bahti hai.

blocks.prompt: Ecosystem mein tawanai ki harkat ghizai ajza se kaise mukhtalif hai?
blocks.explanation: Ghizai ajza zinda aur be-jaan hisson ke darmiyan chakkar lagate hain; tawanai aik taraf bahti, dhoop ban kar aati aur garmi ban kar jati hai.

items: Maadda chakkar lagata; tawanai aik taraf bahti.
